entities.name: Torens
entities.description: A former Mausoleum Guard and cathar turned peddler of dubious goods who carries a stolen holy mace and agrees to investigate a keep for Vytas.

entities.name: Vytas
entities.description: The wealthy, coercive lord of Traublassen who hires Torens to investigate the keep and who is attacked by the townsfolk at the end.

entities.name: Boris
entities.description: Vytas's burly son and head of the trapper corps, who guides Torens to the keep and locks him in.

entities.name: Aleksandar
entities.description: A young blacksmith's son and stable hand whose rent Torens pays and who follows him into the keep, where he is possessed.

entities.name: Eruth
entities.description: A woman shackled in the keep, a prophet with visions of deaths who is accompanied by a companion she calls the Dark Lady.

entities.name: Umbris
entities.description: A spirit bound by the sorcerer Taivas in the keep who takes the townsfolk's fears and sorrows each night and possesses Aleksandar's body.

entities.name: The Dark Lady
entities.description: A companion whom only Eruth perceives, who gives her information and saved her from the madness.

entities.name: Elamon
entities.description: Torens's older brother, a garrison guard in Hanweir who tried to keep him honest and whose letter Torens read too late.

entities.name: Taivas
entities.description: Vytas's great-grandfather, the sorcerer who founded Traublassen and bound Umbris in the keep.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: A commander who took Torens into the cathars and was later ousted from the Lunarch Council.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: Thraben's new guardian, to whom Odric offered to put in a word for Torens.

entities.name: Ingrid
entities.description: A zealous cathar who chased Torens out of Silbern.

entities.name: Captain Lysandra
entities.description: Elamon's captain in the Hanweir garrison.

entities.name: Rogel
entities.description: A contact with whom Torens was to finalize a contraband deal.

entities.name: Marguerite
entities.description: A celebrated Gavony bard performing at Jorelda's Pub.

entities.name: Vytas's hunters
entities.description: Vytas's trapper corps and associates who capture prisoners to give to Umbris.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: The church's soldiers, who pursue Torens for a stolen weapon.

entities.name: Inquisitors
entities.description: A group in the church that executes prophets deemed heretics.

entities.name: Devils
entities.description: Small demonic servants of Umbris who kidnap Aleksandar and carry out his will.

entities.name: Torens's mace
entities.description: A holy weapon Torens stole from the cathars that sheds white light and tingles in the presence of spirits and fiends.

entities.name: Traublassen
entities.description: A village near the Kessig-Stensia border founded by Taivas and ruled by Vytas, with a keep above it.

entities.name: The keep
entities.description: A ruined keep above Traublassen built by Taivas with an ossuary of memories beneath it where Umbris is bound.

entities.name: Hanweir
entities.description: Torens's hometown in Gavony, which was swallowed and left an empty pit.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The high city and seat of the church.

entities.name: Lambholt
entities.description: Eruth's home village.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane lost in endless night.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: The catastrophe before which Torens served as a Mausoleum Guard.

events.summary: Torens hawks his dubious goods in Traublassen and is mocked until Vytas steps in and blackmails him with the cathars looking for him.
events.quote: It would be a shame if someone aided them in their search.

events.summary: At Vytas's manor Torens meets Aleksandar, who asks for more time on his rent, and Torens argues on his behalf.
Vytas offers Torens fifty gold coins to investigate a keep making screeching noises, and Torens takes the first half and asks about the boy's rent.
events.quote: Vytas counted out twenty-five, one by one, and slid them across his desk into a pile.

events.summary: In a flashback, twelve-year-old Torens pickpockets gold in Hanweir and his brother Elamon rescues him.
events.quote: Elamon snatched the coins and tossed them back at the wealthy man.

events.summary: Boris guides Torens to the keep, unlocks the iron door with a brass sphere, and locks them inside along with Aleksandar who followed to repay Torens.
events.quote: He shut and locked the door behind them.

events.summary: Aleksandar charges up the stairs toward a scream and is taken by devils in the smoke.
In a flashback to the town watch era, Torens, now twenty-one, flees a contraband deal when Elamon arrests him.
events.quote: he picked up the stein and whipped its contents into Elamon's face

events.summary: Torens finds the shackled prophet Eruth, who says the devils took the boy to their master.
events.quote: "The devils took the boy to their master."

events.summary: Torens frees Eruth, who explains that cathars wanted to execute her for her visions and that the Dark Lady helped her.
In a flashback, Torens returns to Hanweir to find the entire town gone and reads Elamon's letter too late.
events.quote: as if the entire town, all at once, had been gouged out of the earth

events.summary: Torens and Eruth descend through a bone-lined ossuary of captured memories and find Aleksandar's body possessed by Umbris.
Umbris explains that the sorcerer Taivas bound him to take the villagers' sorrows in exchange for tribute victims, and reveals that he took Aleksandar's memory of his sister.
events.quote: The anguish he felt at discovering the corpse of his young sister is . . . delectable.

events.summary: Umbris tempts Torens to give up his pain and walk away in exchange for purpose and rewards.
events.quote: "Allow me to take your pain away and give you purpose.

events.summary: Torens strikes the binding circle with his mace, freeing Umbris, and then makes a proposal to him.
events.quote: When the head of the mace met the binding circle, the impact sent a thunderclap pealing throughout the catacomb

events.summary: Torens leaves as the townsfolk turn on Vytas and Boris, and Eruth stays to guide them.
events.quote: "I'm staying. These people will need guidance."

events.summary: Umbris leaves Aleksandar's body, and Torens comforts the boy as the mob stones Vytas.
events.quote: Umbris relinquished control of Aleksandar, who collapsed into Torens's arms.

relations.quote: his older brother Elamon, who stood one and a half heads over everyone else in the market

relations.note: He built the keep's door and bound Umbris there.
relations.quote: "My great-great-grandfather Taivas built this door," Boris said
In exchange, Taivas's lineage furnishes me with what I need.
chief among Vytas's trapper corps was Boris

relations.note: They go down to rescue Aleksandar.
relations.quote: "I am coming with you, Torens of Hanweir.

relations.note: He pays the family's rent and protects him.
Odric brought Torens into the cathars.
relations.quote: Someone less understanding than Odric would have jailed him and left him to rot.

relations.note: A village on the Kessig-Stensia border.
relations.quote: The extra half day of travel along the Kessig-Stensia border
